rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §1/§3/§9; flat LIGHT backgrounds; product cut out; 1–3 words on screen; a detailed 2-D object in every shot; watermark below content; logo end card; audio LOCKED. Length 45–55 s, HARD CAP 58 s. Draw no Motorola/Snapdragon/B&O logos (text names only). '12,000 nits' always with pill 'Motorola says · peak'. EU prices always with the country names and '12/512 GB, same phone'.
official_clips: optional: motorola.com PDP camera_01 HLS (assets_sources.md) ≤ 3 s muted; else stills only
palette_for_this_video: paper main; sky for the numbers; blush for THE CATCH; mint for SPEC
new_objects: euroMap (simplified 2-country silhouettes DE/IT side by side with price flags that drop in; reuse for any regional price gap) — add to render/kit/OBJECTS.md if missing. Reuse: priceTag, questionStamp, phoneOutline, battery, counter, lensStack/zoom ring, sunGauge or gauge, calendar, scale, pill, crossMark, scoreTable.

scenes.anchor: Motorola wants sixteen hundred dollars… for a phone.
scenes.image: A cut out centred 80% width, slow push-in

scenes.object: phoneOutline traces the edge; label 'Signature 27 · 12/512 GB'

scenes.anchor: You can buy it in the US today.
scenes.object: calendar page flips to 'NOV 26'; pill 'US · unlocked'

scenes.anchor: Get this. A seven thousand milliamp-hour battery.
scenes.object: battery fills 0→100% while counter rolls 0→'7,000 mAh'; pill '+35% vs last gen'

scenes.image: D (exploded lens) 75% then E zoom frames 01→04 as a 1.5 s zoom-in card
scenes.object: lensStack rings slide apart; counter '200 MP'; pill '3x optical'

scenes.anchor: Twelve thousand nits of peak brightness, says Motorola.
scenes.object: gauge/sun dial sweeps to max, counter '12,000 nits'; pill 'Motorola says · peak'

scenes.anchor: And seven years of Android updates!
scenes.object: calendar stack flips 2026→2033 (7 pages), counter '7 years'

scenes.anchor: Here's the catch. In Germany, it's eighteen ninety-nine euros.
scenes.object: new euroMap: Germany silhouette with priceTag '€1,899' (text 'Germany')
euroMap: Italy silhouette drops in with priceTag '€1,399'

scenes.anchor: Same phone, five hundred euros apart.
scenes.image: two copies of A side by side 35% each
scenes.object: scale tips toward Germany; pill '12/512 GB · same phone'; counter '€500 (36%)'

scenes.anchor: By our score? Fifty-eight out of a hundred.

scenes.anchor: It's a spec. Grab it if battery life matters most to you.
